# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE3_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are testing whether a tight stop (35% of premium), 150% take profit, chandelier profit-lock arming at 50%, and volume ratio threshold of 1.0 can capture edge in the shotgun_scalper framework. The edge appears strong in wide_pnl but fails to capture the source-of-truth J day edge, suggesting overfit to non-J day market regimes.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Triggered when volume ratio >= 1.0 (vol_ratio_threshold) and other shotgun_scalper stage3 conditions (not detailed here) are met.  
**Exit:**  
- Take profit at 150% of entry premium (tp_premium_pct=1.5)  
- Stop loss at 35% of entry premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35) — meaning exit if premium falls to 35% of entry (65% loss)  
- Time stop at 15 minutes  
- Chandelier profit-lock: arms when trade reaches 50% profit (chandelier_arm_pct=0.5), then trails high-water mark by 15% (fixed parameter not in combo)  
- Strike selection: OTM-2 for puts / ITM-2 for calls (strike_offset=2)

## Confidence

2 / 10 -- Strong wide_pnl but poor J day edge capture (edge_capture=285 < 771 floor) indicates likely overfit to non-J days. Parameters lack grounding in source-of-truth trades (J anchor days). Requires significant rework to improve J day performance.
